description: This Java file defines the MetadataParser class responsible for parsing the header and footer of bug report files in the Android project. It extracts metadata such as start time, build ID, and calculates end time based on duration.

classes.name: MetadataParser
classes.description: A class for parsing header and footer information from bug report data.

methods.name: setBugreport
methods.description: Associates a Bugreport object to store parsed information.

methods.name: parseHeader
methods.description: Parses the header lines of a bug report to extract metadata like start time and build ID.

methods.name: parseFooter
methods.description: Parses the footer to set the end time based on the start time and duration.
